normalization: Per mole of NaCl: n=2 and V_m=v*58.44cm3/mol. Per mole of conventional B1 cells: n=8 and volume4*V_m gives exactly the same pressure. Wrong n means an inconsistent atom/volume basis, not merely use of8. Fe2SiO4 similarly has n=7 per formula or56 per conventional cell with8times the formula molar volume.

brown_tables.scope: All571 populated calculated pressure cells; equal weight per cell. Pressure differences are prediction minus TableII, GPa; no original experimental refit.
brown_tables.interpretation: TableII temperature slopes support n=2. An added E_ZP/3, E_ZP=9*n*R*theta/8, reproduces the offset closely and is algebraically equivalent to changing D3's linear coefficient from-3/8 to-1/4. This is a numerical signature, not recovered Brown code or a justified correction. Eq1/TableI define a zero-K baseline, so adding zero-point pressure needs a consistent redefinition of that baseline.

table_s1.scope: All18 rows retained; all objectives/summaries use14 accepted rows only, unweighted GPa residuals, no fitted EOS coefficients. No temperature uncertainty/covariance or significance inferred.
table_s1.hypothesis_definitions: Names with half_kelvin use Tsample/2 for heating only; cold preheat/quench states stay300K. n1_full_sample uses one atom per formula with the formula molar volume, intentionally a mismatched basis. minus_E300 subtracts a300K thermal energy from an already zero-K P0 and is deliberately an error hypothesis. TableII reconstructions keep its offset; TableI cases keep its printed baseline. Celsius halving means(Tsample-273.15)/2+273.15. ZPE/3 cases are diagnostics, not corrections.
table_s1.interpretation: Half-Kelvin n2 is favored among tested fixed-temperature/n alternatives, but the extra300K-reference subtraction is comparably close. The pressure table does not uniquely identify the historical workflow. A fitted noninteger n is a diagnostic scaling parameter, not a revised atom count. Cold excluded rows disfavor applying extra300K subtraction globally, but cannot rule out a separate heating routine. No source code recovered.

ringwoodite_n_curve_check.scope: Nine digitized calculated thermal curves, not experimental observations. Published gamma0=1.08,q=2,theta0=685K and static parameters held fixed. Conditional check under integrated theta reconstruction, not recovered author code or an independent physical measurement of n.

source_search: Brown's public institutional Publications/Papers lists, four tool/example ZIPs plusExamples.zip, and public jmichaelb repository trees were checked. No1999 NaCl Debye calculator found; author2020 supplement only corroborates literalTableI P0/V/K/Kprime. No author contacted.
